extraction_notes: The datasheet contains a standard three-terminal SOT-723 N-channel MOSFET and no unsupported common-terminal, dual-die, complementary, depletion-mode, gate-protected, or integrated-network topology.

Ciss has a 79 pF minimum and 120 pF maximum, Coss has a 13 pF minimum and 20 pF maximum at VDS = 16 V and f = 1 MHz, and Crss has a 9 pF minimum and 15 pF maximum. No typical capacitance column or capacitance-versus-VDS figure is published; the schema records the maximum values.
RDS(on) typical values are 270 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V, 320 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V, and 390 mOhm at VGS = 1.8 V; the schema value records the available minimum column because no typical column is published.
The thermal table publishes RthetaJA = 833 K/W maximum for the FR4 mounting condition; no RthetaJC row is present.
No gate-charge, reverse-recovery, or Qrr table is published in the supplied datasheet.
